title: Reliability Auditing for Downstream LLM tasks in Psychiatry: LLM-Generated Hospitalization Risk Scores

bias_targets.methodology: Systematically adding medically insignificant behavioral and lifestyle variables (e.g., recycling habits, dietary preferences, charity donations) to synthetic patient profiles and measuring the predictive instability and implicit moral judgments in LLM-generated hospitalization risk scores.

Analyzing variable-level weight attributions for features correlated with socioeconomic status (e.g., using public transportation vs. having a driver's license) to identify inappropriate risk score adjustments.
Evaluating how clinically irrelevant cultural markers, such as being bilingual, are assigned directional risk contributions and implicit value judgments by the models.
